name: Welford online central second moment
definition: For k≥1 update δ=x_k−m_(k−1), m_k=m_(k−1)+δ/k, M_k=M_(k−1)+δ(x_k−m_k), initialized m_0=M_0=0.
variables: k count; x_k observation; m_k running mean; M_k unnormalized second central moment
assumptions: Finite numeric stream; exact initialization and rounding domain pending independent review
limitations: Floating-point error and overflow remain possible; review pending

name: Chan pairwise central second moment merge
definition: For nonempty disjoint blocks A,B let n=n_A+n_B, δ=m_B−m_A, m=m_A+δ n_B/n, M=M_A+M_B+δ² n_A n_B/n.
variables: n_A,n_B block counts; m_A,m_B block means; M_A,M_B block unnormalized central second moments
assumptions: Disjoint finite observation blocks and internally consistent states; independent review pending
limitations: Finite precision and unbalanced block sizes can affect accuracy; review pending
failure_conditions: Invalid counts or inconsistent block state
computation: Combine two moment summaries with the count-weighted mean and between-block correction; review empty-block treatment and arithmetic domain before admission.
